description: This is a bar chart titled "Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)" with the y-axis labeled "Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)" ranging from 0.00 to 1.00 in linear scale, and the x-axis labeled with two categories: "GPT-4o" and "GPT-4o-mini". The chart displays three bars for each category: a gray bar labeled "Control", a light blue bar labeled "Before Introspection Training", and a dark purple bar labeled "After Introspection Training". For the "GPT-4o" category, the gray control bar reaches approximately 0.08, the light blue "Before" bar reaches approximately 0.53, and the dark purple "After" bar reaches approximately 0.75. For the "GPT-4o-mini" category, the gray control bar is near 0.00, the light blue "Before" bar reaches approximately 0.51, and the dark purple "After" bar reaches approximately 0.75. All bars have vertical error bars indicating 95% HDIs. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each model, with the "After Introspection Training" bars being the tallest, followed by the "Before" bars, and the "Control" bars being the shortest. The chart is not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding.
